name: 林祐正
objective: This course introduces fundamental concepts and applications of automation and intelligent technologies in the construction industry. Topics include construction robotics, smart materials, sensing and Internet of Things (IoT), Building Information Modeling (BIM), Robotics, and artificial intelligence (AI) for construction automation. Through case studies and practical examples, students will understand how construction automation enhances productivity, safety, and resilience in construction and building projects.
schedule:
Major topics of this course
1. Introduction to Construction and Building Automation
2. Automation in construction Site
3. Hardware for Construction and Building Automation 
4. Software for Construction and Building Automation
5. Applications of Construction and Building Automation 
6. BIM for Construction and Building Automation 
7. AI-based Application for Construction and Building Automation
8. Robotics for Construction and Building Automation
9. The Special Topic for Construction and Building Automation
10. Case Studies for Construction and Building Automation
scorePolicy:

2. Assignments (60%)
